body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #8, company drawn at random (seed 20261205) from IT / FMCG / Consumer Durables names in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.35 (naive base rate 0.4) that: Uttam Distilleries Ltd (83.73% subsidiary) commissions its 40 -> 160 KLPD expansion on or before 31-Mar-2027 (Reg-30 29-Sep-2025: 'By March, 2027', Rs 110 cr). Our reasoning: AR26 says 'in progress'; the 31-Oct-2026 deck still lists UDL at 40 KLPD and gives no progress; no Reg-30 on orders or commissioning; grain plants are favoured in the ESY 2026-27 tender, which supports completion. Naive base: Dated capacity promises in our ledgers are met on time roughly 40% of the time (L26: dates slip) [EST]. Resolution: YES only if a company document (Reg-30, results, deck or AR FY27) dated on or before 2027-05-31 states that UDL's 160 KLPD capacity (or the added 120 KLPD) was commissioned or put to commercial production on or before 2027-03-31. Source: NSE/BSE announcements, AR FY27. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
